nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the trusted signer whose ECDSA signature authorizes a claim.
Public string state variable holding the base URI used by _baseURI for token metadata.
Mapping(address => uint256) of per-recipient claim nonces used inside the claim signing hash to prevent signature replay.
Public initializer that sets up ERC721, UUPS and Ownable, and assigns signVerifier and baseURI.
Internal virtual override guarded by onlyOwner that authorizes UUPS implementation upgrades.
External view returning claimNonces[recipient] for signature construction.
Public view building keccak256 hash of blockExpiry, recipient, tokenId, address(this) and the recipient nonce.
External view returning the current signVerifier address.
Owner-only function that writes a new value into the signVerifier state variable.
Owner-only function that writes a new value into the baseURI state variable.
Owner-only function that safely mints tokenId to recipient via _safeMint.
Public function verifying an off-chain signature, checking block expiry, incrementing the nonce and safely transferring the token.
Overridden ERC721 transferFrom intentionally left empty to disable normal transfers.
Overridden ERC721 safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256) intentionally left empty.
Overridden ERC721 safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256,bytes) intentionally left empty.
Internal view override returning the baseURI state variable.
Caller-controlled address used through _msgSender() by the onlyOwner access control modifier.
ECDSA.recover(message, sig) call in claimNFT that validates the supplied signature against signVerifier.
_safeTransfer external call in claimNFT that invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, enabling reentrancy.
claimNonces[recipient]++ state mutation in claimNFT performed before the external transfer.
sig bytes parameter of claimNFT containing the off-chain signature.
blockExpiry uint256 parameter of claimNFT bounding the block number at which the signature is valid.
recipient address parameter of claimNFT receiving the token.
tokenId uint256 parameter of claimNFT identifying the token to claim.
Local bytes32 message in claimNFT holding the eth-signed hash passed to ECDSA.recover.
Local address from in claimNFT holding ownerOf(tokenId), used as the transfer source.
verifier address parameter of setSignVerifier written into signVerifier.
uri string parameter of setBaseURI written into baseURI.
recipient address parameter of mint receiving the newly minted token.
tokenId uint256 parameter of mint identifying the token to mint.
name string parameter of initialize used for ERC721 initialization.
symbol string parameter of initialize used for ERC721 initialization.
newImplementation address parameter of _authorizeUpgrade.
_safeMint external callback in mint that invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner() by the onlyOwner modifier guarding _authorizeUpgrade, so an unauthorized caller can be rejected or the owner can upgrade.
onlyOwner on setSignVerifier restricts the caller via _msgSender(); a wrong check would let an attacker replace the signer.
onlyOwner on setBaseURI restricts the caller via _msgSender().
onlyOwner on mint restricts the caller via _msgSender().
setSignVerifier writes the verifier argument into the signVerifier state variable.
setBaseURI writes the uri argument into the baseURI state variable.
getSignVerifier reads and returns the signVerifier state variable.
getClaimNonce reads claimNonces[recipient] from storage.
The per-recipient claimNonces value is embedded into the signing hash produced by getClaimSigningHash.
claimNFT calls getClaimSigningHash to build the message it verifies.
claimNFT passes the computed message and the caller-supplied sig into the ECDSA.recover operation.
claimNFT assigns the eth-signed hash result to the local message variable.
The local message hash is the input supplied to ECDSA.recover.
claimNFT performs the claimNonces[recipient]++ arithmetic update on state.
The increment operation mutates the claimNonces state variable.
claimNFT calls _safeTransfer, which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, handing control to external code.
The recipient's onERC721Received callback can re-enter claimNFT during the safe transfer.
The local from address obtained from ownerOf(tokenId) is the source argument of _safeTransfer.
The recipient parameter of claimNFT is used both in the signing hash and as the transfer destination.
The blockExpiry parameter of claimNFT is used in the signing hash and in the block.number expiry requirement.
The sig parameter of claimNFT is forwarded to ECDSA.recover.
The tokenId parameter of claimNFT selects the token to query and transfer.
tokenId is an input to the getClaimSigningHash signing hash construction.
initialize assigns the default signVerifier state variable.
initialize assigns the default baseURI state variable.
The verifier parameter flows into the signVerifier state write inside setSignVerifier.
The uri parameter flows into the baseURI state write inside setBaseURI.
The recipient parameter of mint is passed to _safeMint as the token owner.
The tokenId parameter of mint is passed to _safeMint as the token identifier.
The name parameter of initialize is forwarded to __ERC721_init.
The symbol parameter of initialize is forwarded to __ERC721_init.
The newImplementation parameter of _authorizeUpgrade is the upgrade target address checked before upgrading.
mint calls _safeMint, which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, handing control to external code.
The recipient's onERC721Received callback can re-enter the minting context.

normalization_plan.reason: The sig parameter only exists within claimNFT and is consumed by its signature verification logic.
blockExpiry is a claimNFT parameter used for its expiry check and signing hash.
The recipient parameter belongs to claimNFT and drives its hash and transfer logic.
The tokenId parameter belongs to claimNFT and selects the claimed token.
Local message is the hash produced and immediately consumed by ECDSA.recover in claimNFT.
Local from is resolved by ownerOf and used directly as the source of the _safeTransfer call.
verifier is the sole parameter of setSignVerifier and is written to storage.
uri is the sole parameter of setBaseURI and is written to storage.
The recipient parameter of mint is forwarded to _safeMint.
The tokenId parameter of mint is forwarded to _safeMint.
name is an initialize parameter consumed by __ERC721_init.
symbol is an initialize parameter consumed by __ERC721_init.
newImplementation is the parameter received by the upgrade authorization function.
